generation_channel.product: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian) metered model inference API
generation_channel.authentication: Bearer authentication with the server-local DASHSCOPE_KEY; the credential and private base URL were not retained

image_call.response_evidence: Each successful response contained output.choices[0].message.content[0].image; the expiring signed result URL was downloaded server-side and discarded

generation_channel.execution: A short script ran on the production host, read only the two named environment variables, called the image API there, returned only generated images, and removed its temporary directory
generation_channel.maintainer_attestation: No non-sensitive request id was retained. The maintainer attests that all 20 successful image responses came from this authenticated API call; this is not independent third-party proof.

rights.originality: The prompts and character concepts were authored for nanoMuse; no existing IP, trademark, logo, celebrity or real person was requested.
rights.ai_label: These files are AI-generated examples. This manifest is the durable AI-generation label shipped beside the canonical assets.
rights.contribution: The API caller contributes under GPL-3.0-or-later every copyright or related right they may hold in the prompts, selection, edits and outputs. No claim is made that copyright subsists in model output where applicable law says otherwise.
rights.service_basis: The model card names Alibaba Cloud Model Studio as the inference provider. Bailian Service Agreement section 7.5 says qualifying rights in output from Alibaba or affiliate models remain with the customer, subject to law and other agreements.
rights.experience_exclusion: The images were made through the authenticated model-inference API, not Model Studio experience. The Experience Feature Special Notice separately restricts experience output and does not describe this call path.
rights.release_review: A maintainer must confirm the linked terms are still current before release; this provenance is factual project documentation, not legal advice.
